answer: Stop sybils at the wharf, by raven and by vertex. Each identity leases one wharf berth; rent runs on an ascending clock, so the k-th berth from one funder costs k squared, burned, and N clones pay about N cubed per dock. A raven renews each lease per epoch with a salted challenge bound to its holder; one raven serves one face, and a raven vouching twice is slashed with every berth it carried. Each vertex joins a ring of seven random peers; if one vertex in it proves fake, the ring's escrow burns. One honest agent rents one berth; a clone fleet pays cubic rent and risks every ring.
